description: User-directed 2026-07-18 UX hardening slate: robust GPX/path editing controls on the shipped path editor; toolbar-as-context-menu (top-bar buttons select what renders in the inspector/left-sidebar region, core inspector gets its own toolbar icon, TOOL_DEFS stays the single-source table); smoothed/damped gimbal drag interactions; clear, calm selection highlighting with smooth transitions for both paths and objects generally; and camera hardening (terrain ground-clamp so close-up work never dives below terrain, scale-aware min-distance defaults, eased motion) — FR-5 added 2026-07-18 same-day from the user's camera ask
notes:
P0 user-driven UX pillar (roadmap defers UX direction to the user). Verbatim user ask 2026-07-18: 'hardening the GPX controls and updating the tool placement; the top bar can act as a context menu for what shows in the inspector left side bar area with the core inspector getting an icon as well; we need clean gimbal interactions and better smoothing and highlighting for track selection and honestly object selection in general'. Constraint: the two-selection-concept split (NodeManager.selected vs PathEditorState.editing_track_id) is CODIFIED in conductor/code_styleguides/ui_ux.md §5 — highlight both authorities distinctly, do not unify them here. Recent prior art to build on, not duplicate: staged Escape + petal-switch reset + TOOL_DEFS table (toolbar.rs), 906d9cc UX batch (narrow-phase picking, centroid ribbons, inspector units).
VALIDATED 2026-07-19: in_progress (confirmed) — only Phase 5/FR-5 landed + committed at 320ebfe (fe-renderer/src/camera.rs: scaled_min_distance, min_pitch_above_ground, height_at, clamp_above_ground, all with green pinned tests; fe-renderer/src/AGENTS.md documents it). FR-1 (GPX control hardening), FR-2 (toolbar-as-context-menu — ToolDef in toolbar.rs still has no sidebar-context discriminant), FR-3 (gimbal drag damping — no damping/smoothing module found in gimbal_interaction.rs or path_gimbal_drag.rs), and FR-4 (selection highlighting — no SELECT_HIGHLIGHT/highlight_for constant in theme.rs or fe-renderer) all show NO implementation evidence in the codebase. remaining: FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, FR-4 (Phases 1-4 of plan.md) entirely unstarted; only Phase 5 (camera) + Phase 6 close-out remain to reach done.
